correctness.rationale: All coefficient rows stay dyadic and sum to one; general position and mean conservation identify opinion consensus with every row equal to the uniform row. The sum of Shannon entropies must increase from 0 to 24, while mixing two rows gives at most 2 bits by conditioning on a fair input-source bit. Equality identifies the source from the sampled label, i.e. disjoint supports. Starting at the terminal uniform rows and reversing, disjointness forces each contributing parent to be uniform on exactly half of the merged support. Thus at length 12 every agent participates once at each of the three support-doubling stages. Conversely twelve valid equal-cardinality disjoint unions reach entropy 24 and hence consensus; no shorter word qualifies. I independently reproduced the count using triples of perfect matchings and exact linear-extension counts, not the frozen forward state recurrence. For a fixed first matching, 384 viable triples each admit 49,920 words and 96 each admit 51,200. There are 105 choices of the first matching by relabeling. Thus 105*(384*49920+96*51200)=2528870400, and exact reduction after division by 28^12 gives 225/20661046784. The same method gives 24 of 1296 four-agent words.
correctness.replay: Recursively list matchings by pairing the least remaining label with each possible partner. Fix the first matching; for each of the following two stages loop over all matchings and retain those joining disjoint supports of their endpoints, replacing each endpoint support by the union. For each retained triple put one node per contact and add precedence from each endpoint's contact at the previous stage. Record its parent set p_j. On the performed-node subset B set E(full)=1 and E(B)=sum E(B union {j}) over j not in B with p_j subset B; tally E(empty) over triples. Disjoint-agent contacts cannot affect one another's inputs, so every such order is legal, and a chronological word uniquely determines each agent's three ranks and the triple. Independent Python replay ran this algorithm; the stated histogram is the output.
residual_risks: The count is finite and label-sensitive, with no claim for sixteen agents or non-general-position inputs.

value.rationale: The exact minimum-horizon probability was an explicit question for the same stochastic model, and eight agents are its first untreated size. The exact word-sensitive count is a meaningful benchmark for fastest possible uncoordinated averaging, not merely the minimum contact bound or a topology table.
residual_risks: It is not a typical latency, general-size formula, approximate-consensus guarantee, or full hitting-time distribution.
